policy: Offline reuse of recorded bibliographic metadata/rights; no source prose, private inputs, emails or network. New applications have basis IDs and explicit source-alignment limitations.

claims.statement: After drainage of an uncomplicated cutaneous abscess, adjunctive MRSA-active antibiotics offer modest benefits and adverse effects, so a universal no-antibiotic rule is not supported.
claims.limitation: Local resistance, allergy, comorbidity, severity, immune status, and adverse-effect risk affect the separate antibiotic decision.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults after drainage of an uncomplicated cutaneous abscess.

claims.statement: A confirmed, clinically meaningful, uncomplicated cutaneous abscess is treated primarily with incision and drainage.
claims.limitation: Very small collections, special sites, deep infection, vascular mimics, immunocompromise, and systemic illness require individualized management.
claims.applicablePopulation: Stable adults with a discrete superficial cutaneous abscess confirmed on ultrasound.

claims.statement: A small, asymptomatic, core-proven fibroadenoma that is radiologically and pathologically concordant and lacks atypia or concern for phyllodes tumor can be managed without routine excision.
claims.limitation: This does not apply to discordance, atypia, phyllodes concern, symptoms, substantial growth, or a patient preference for removal.
claims.applicablePopulation: Stable adults with an asymptomatic concordant fibroadenoma proven by core biopsy.

claims.statement: When examination cannot distinguish cellulitis from a superficial abscess, targeted soft-tissue ultrasound can identify a drainable collection.
claims.limitation: An obvious superficial abscess does not need imaging before drainage; operator skill, depth, anatomy, and vascular mimics affect interpretation.
claims.applicablePopulation: Stable adults with an equivocal superficial skin infection and no necrotizing, vascular, deep-space, breast, or perianal concern.

claims.statement: Perioperative risk in cirrhosis depends on liver severity, portal hypertension and decompensation, procedure type, comorbidity, and center experience; no one score or laboratory value captures the whole decision.
claims.limitation: Single expert-review source; no fixed mortality estimate is taught.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with cirrhosis being considered for nonhepatic surgery.

claims.statement: Active decompensation supports multidisciplinary optimization before proceeding with a nonurgent elective plan; deferral is an inferred case-specific boundary rather than an automatic prohibition.
claims.limitation: Urgent surgical emergencies require immediate assessment despite elevated risk.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with cirrhosis and a proposed nonurgent elective operation.

claims.statement: Initial thyroid surgical extent is individualized from tumor extent and laterality, nodal or distant disease, recurrence considerations, future treatment needs, and patient preferences.
claims.limitation: No operation is selected from age alone or mandated for every DTC.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with confirmed differentiated thyroid cancer.

claims.statement: Malignant thyroid cytology or molecular findings warrant preoperative central and lateral neck ultrasonography to assess cervical nodes and gross local extension.
claims.limitation: No unchecked numeric node threshold is taught.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults proceeding toward surgery for differentiated thyroid cancer confirmed by cytology or molecular findings.

claims.statement: After CT assesses postoperative collections, contrast-enhanced MRCP with a hepatobiliary agent can anatomically localize a suspected bile leak and evaluate duct continuity; scintigraphy can demonstrate active leakage but has limited spatial detail.
claims.limitation: The dedicated hepatobiliary-contrast study is a distinct external service; this claim does not make MRCP the first test in an unstable patient.
claims.applicablePopulation: Stable post-cholecystectomy adults after CT excludes an uncontrolled collection.

claims.statement: A persistent minor postoperative bile leak with preserved common-duct continuity can be referred for ERCP with transpapillary plastic-stent treatment.
claims.limitation: Excludes sepsis, peritonitis, uncontrolled collections, and complete common-bile-duct or common-hepatic-duct transection.
claims.applicablePopulation: Stable patients with a persistent minor post-cholecystectomy leak and preserved duct continuity.

claims.statement: Sentinel-node biopsy is ordinarily performed with mastectomy for pure DCIS because later lymphatic mapping may be unreliable.
claims.limitation: Single current society source; standard setting without a planned delayed magnetic-tracer strategy.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults undergoing mastectomy for pure DCIS.

claims.statement: Routine axillary surgery is generally omitted for pure DCIS treated with uncomplicated breast-conserving surgery when invasion is not suspected.
claims.limitation: Single current society source.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults undergoing routine breast conservation for pure DCIS without concern for invasion.

claims.statement: Sentinel-node biopsy is appropriate when the planned DCIS operation will compromise later mapping or when occult invasion is meaningfully suspected.
claims.limitation: Single current society source; case-specific judgment remains required.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults undergoing DCIS surgery with threatened future mapping or concern for occult invasion.

claims.statement: A clinically suspicious persistent palpable breast mass requires tissue diagnosis even when diagnostic mammography and targeted ultrasonography are negative.
claims.limitation: Single current specialty guideline; biopsy technique depends on whether an imaging target exists and local specialist assessment.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with a persistently suspicious palpable breast mass despite negative mammography and targeted ultrasound.

claims.statement: When reduced plasma bicarbonate suggests metabolic acidosis, blood-gas assessment confirms the acidemia and identifies respiratory or mixed acid-base contributions.
claims.limitation: R1.1 is expert opinion; arterial sampling is not claimed universally superior.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with reduced plasma bicarbonate and suspected metabolic acidosis.

claims.statement: In acute hyperkalaemia, intravenous calcium protects cardiac membrane physiology but does not lower serum potassium, whereas insulin with glucose shifts potassium into cells.
claims.limitation: The July 2026 calcium recommendation is 2C after no evidence for or against outcome benefit; no dose, timing, or survival claim is taught.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults receiving hospital treatment for acute hyperkalaemia.

claims.statement: Under the current UKKA adult pathway, a confirmed community potassium concentration of at least 6.5 mmol/L warrants immediate hospital assessment and treatment.
claims.limitation: This is a UK guideline threshold, not a universal jurisdictional rule or an exact arrhythmia probability.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with confirmed severe hyperkalaemia detected in the community.

claims.statement: Validated preoperative screening can identify adults at increased probability of obstructive sleep apnoea for perioperative communication, but screening does not establish the diagnosis.
claims.limitation: No proprietary questionnaire, item wording, score cutoff, or guaranteed outcome benefit is reproduced.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults undergoing preoperative assessment.

claims.statement: Documented hyperacute allograft rejection can be driven by recipient antibodies that were present before transplantation and recognize donor antigens.
claims.limitation: Narrow mechanism from a transplant review plus an independent commissioned background cross-check. Early graft dysfunction alone does not prove rejection or this mechanism; no transplant timing threshold or treatment is inferred.
claims.applicablePopulation: Stable adults reviewing an outside-confirmed historical hyperacute allograft event.

claims.statement: Preformed donor-specific antibodies can bind allograft endothelium and initiate complement-associated vascular injury and thrombosis in hyperacute rejection.
claims.limitation: One adequately licensed review supplies this narrow vascular mechanism. No claim that all acute rejection is antibody-mediated or that T-cell and antibody mechanisms cannot coexist.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults discussing a documented historical donor-specific antibody-mediated graft injury.

claims.statement: Pneumoperitoneum pressure that compresses abdominal veins or the vena cava can reduce venous return and cardiac preload; this is a possible mechanism in the supplied compression context, not an inevitable effect of laparoscopy.
claims.limitation: No numeric pressure threshold, automatic hypotension rule, or universal cardiac-output direction is inferred. Both pressure and other perioperative factors contribute to hemodynamic observations.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults reviewing a completed laparoscopic operation with documented pressure-associated venous compression.

claims.statement: Peritoneal CO2 absorption adds a CO2 load; when pulmonary elimination does not match that load, blood CO2 can rise and produce respiratory acidemia.
claims.limitation: Ventilation and respiratory mechanics also affect blood CO2. The current observational study cannot establish every mechanistic contribution; these cases supply completed-care records rather than asking the clinic to select ventilator settings or manage live hypercarbia.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults reviewing a resolved CO2-associated event in an outside anesthesia record.

claims.statement: After laparoscopy, residual gas and diaphragmatic irritation can stimulate the phrenic sensory pathway and contribute to pain perceived at the shoulder even without a shoulder injury.
claims.limitation: Shoulder pain has multiple possible causes; the proposed phrenic/diaphragmatic mechanism is not proved for every episode. The trial is a gynecologic-population mechanism cross-check; no analgesic, gas-removal procedure or fixed pain duration is prescribed.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with a completed outside laparoscopic cholecystectomy and a fully reassuring clinic assessment.

claims.statement: CO2 used to create pneumoperitoneum can cross peritoneal tissue into blood; absorbed CO2 is carried to the lungs for exhalation.
claims.limitation: Physiology review plus current clinical observational cross-check. No absorption rate, pressure cutoff, or claim that every raised CO2 measurement has this sole cause is authored.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults reviewing completed outside laparoscopic surgery with documented CO2 insufflation.

claims.statement: Pneumoperitoneum hemodynamics depend on pressure, circulating volume, and positioning; early compression of splanchnic veins may increase central filling, while head-up positioning can reduce venous return and head-down positioning can increase it.
claims.limitation: The review directly supports phase/position distinctions, while the independent study corroborates pressure-associated effects rather than every position comparison. No universal preload outcome or operative management instruction is supplied.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults discussing the hemodynamic context in an outside laparoscopy record.

claims.statement: A mild improving shoulder symptom after laparoscopy may be discussed as referred pain only in a reassuring clinical context; breathing difficulty, severe or worsening abdominal pain, fever, persistent vomiting, jaundice, or concerning wound changes require renewed assessment rather than automatic gas-pain reassurance.
claims.limitation: Single current professional-society patient guidance supports these warning features. No exact fever threshold or complete triage algorithm is authored; the stem supplies current benign findings and does not exclude all disease through wording alone.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults discussing shoulder pain after outside laparoscopic gallbladder removal.

claims.statement: Allograft rejection may involve T-cell-mediated or antibody-mediated pathways, and the pathways can coexist; a documented hyperacute preformed-antibody event should not be substituted with an unproven T-cell-only explanation.
claims.limitation: Narrow comparator from the transplant review Abstract; does not classify all acute rejection as T-cell-only, infer a treatment or establish a new active diagnosis.
claims.applicablePopulation: Stable adults reviewing a confirmed historical transplant rejection mechanism.

claims.statement: A persistent unexplained lateral neck mass in an adult requires evaluation for malignancy; a cystic appearance in an older adult does not establish a benign developmental cyst.
claims.limitation: Single independent multidisciplinary guideline directly supports the malignancy/cystic boundary. The cases are adults older than40 with persistent unexplained nonthyroid masses, not a thyroid-nodule, thyroglossal-duct or known benign-cyst objective. No precise duration threshold or definitive cancer diagnosis is inferred.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults older than40 with a persistent unexplained lateral or cystic neck mass.

claims.statement: Core needle biopsy may be appropriate for selected neck masses when the tissue or ancillary testing needed is not adequately supplied by fine-needle aspiration.
claims.limitation: Single guideline; core is acknowledged in feedback and is never an incorrect alternative to FNA. The cases do not ask for lymphoma-specific sampling or prescribe open biopsy after a fixed number of attempts.
claims.applicablePopulation: Specialist-assessed neck masses with technique selection based on pathology requirements.

claims.statement: Cross-sectional neck imaging characterizes anatomy, whereas cell or tissue sampling supplies the material for a cytological or histological diagnosis of an undiagnosed suspicious neck mass.
claims.limitation: Single guideline's independently synthesized distinction between imaging and needle-sampling roles. A supplied CT description does not substitute for a tissue specimen; no universal sequence or guaranteed sampling result is claimed.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with an imaged but still undiagnosed suspicious cervical mass.

claims.statement: After appropriate assessment of an undiagnosed at-risk adult neck mass, fine-needle aspiration is an appropriate initial needle-sampling approach; open incisional or excisional biopsy should not replace the initial needle approach.
claims.limitation: Single independent guideline. FNA is the best offered needle option, not universally preferable to core biopsy. The game action is specialist referral, not a fabricated local generic-FNA procedure or a complete cancer-workup sequence.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with an assessed, undiagnosed suspicious cervical mass requiring an initial needle sample.

claims.statement: Pneumoperitoneum can displace the diaphragm cephalad.
claims.limitation: Single current physiology review; no exact pressure threshold, fixed ventilator setting or automatic diagnosis for sudden airway-pressure elevation is authored.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adult synthetic perioperative or postoperative clinic encounters; no onsite hospital operation is simulated.

claims.statement: Pneumoperitoneum-related mechanical restriction can reduce respiratory compliance and resting lung volume.
claims.limitation: Single current physiology review; no exact pressure threshold, fixed ventilator setting or automatic diagnosis for sudden airway-pressure elevation is authored.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adult synthetic perioperative or postoperative clinic encounters; no onsite hospital operation is simulated.

claims.statement: Lower respiratory compliance can increase the pressure needed to deliver a given tidal volume.
claims.limitation: Single current physiology review; no exact pressure threshold, fixed ventilator setting or automatic diagnosis for sudden airway-pressure elevation is authored.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adult synthetic perioperative or postoperative clinic encounters; no onsite hospital operation is simulated.

claims.statement: Perioperative DNR orders require individualized review with the patient or surrogate and responsible clinicians; automatic suspension bypasses self-determination.
claims.limitation: Ethical guidance does not replace jurisdiction-specific law or institutional policy.
claims.applicablePopulation: People in the stated fictional clinical situation.

claims.statement: The team should clarify requested interventions in the context of anesthesia, identify essential procedures, and document an agreed individualized plan.
claims.limitation: Ethical guidance does not replace jurisdiction-specific law or institutional policy.
claims.applicablePopulation: People in the stated fictional clinical situation.

claims.statement: Perioperative planning should document when the original directive will be reinstated so temporary modifications do not silently become indefinite.
claims.limitation: Ethical guidance does not replace jurisdiction-specific law or institutional policy.
claims.applicablePopulation: People in the stated fictional clinical situation.

claims.statement: DNR concerns resuscitative efforts after arrest; it does not by itself prohibit other appropriate treatment consistent with patient goals.
claims.limitation: Ethical guidance does not replace jurisdiction-specific law or institutional policy.
claims.applicablePopulation: People in the stated fictional clinical situation.

claims.statement: Acute lymphangitis can be recognized clinically when a distal skin entry site is accompanied by a tender erythematous streak extending proximally toward tender regional lymph nodes.
claims.limitation: This narrow claim supports pattern recognition only; it does not establish an organism, severity, testing plan, treatment, prognosis, or disposition. MSD Manual Professional is the sole adequate targeted-verification source retained for this claim; an independent source has not yet been recorded.
claims.applicablePopulation: Patients represented in the approved outpatient clinic vignettes with a distal skin entry site, proximal tender streak, and regional nodal tenderness.

claims.statement: At unchanged tidal volume, inspiratory flow and PEEP, a matched increase in peak and plateau pressure with an unchanged peak-to-plateau difference supports increased elastic pressure requirements rather than an isolated increase in airway resistance.
claims.applicablePopulation: The explicitly controlled or reported adult retrospective profiles in the round-two question-flag drafts.
claims.limitation: Qualitative physical application of the recorded diaphragm/compliance relation. It is not a newly verified ventilator algorithm, universal diagnosis or instruction to choose settings; the question explicitly supplies the acquisition controls.
claims.verificationScope: Offline application/physical inference from previously recorded claims. No source was newly retrieved; source access dates and reuse restrictions remain unchanged. Clinician/source-alignment review is pending.

claims.statement: In the supplied qualitative record, higher arterial CO2 with lower pH and unchanged bicarbonate supports a respiratory CO2-load interpretation rather than a new primary fixed-acid process.
claims.applicablePopulation: The explicitly controlled or reported adult retrospective profiles in the round-two question-flag drafts.
claims.limitation: A case-specific acid-base inference, not a numeric compensation rule, exclusion of every mixed disorder, or proof that peritoneal absorption is the sole cause in every operation.
claims.verificationScope: Offline application/physical inference from previously recorded claims. No source was newly retrieved; source access dates and reuse restrictions remain unchanged. Clinician/source-alignment review is pending.

claims.statement: A STOP-Bang OSA-probability report and an Epworth daytime-sleepiness report address different targets; a reassuring sleepiness report does not establish absence of OSA or turn a probability screen into a confirmed diagnosis.
claims.applicablePopulation: The explicitly controlled or reported adult retrospective profiles in the round-two question-flag drafts.
claims.limitation: Uses names and reported outputs only, without questionnaire items, scoring implementation, numeric cutoffs or diagnostic-study thresholds. The domain application requires anaesthesia/source-alignment review; no fresh verification is claimed.
claims.verificationScope: Offline application/physical inference from previously recorded claims. No source was newly retrieved; source access dates and reuse restrictions remain unchanged. Clinician/source-alignment review is pending.

claims.statement: A matching breast skin-site label does not establish representative sampling when the specimen and needle notch lie in superficial fat and the persistent clinical target lies beneath that plane; a visible clip is not a substitute for the unrepresented target.
claims.applicablePopulation: Only the explicitly described synthetic adult question-flag round-three profiles.
claims.limitation: Case-specific provenance inference. Specialist assessment chooses a representative biopsy technique; it does not mandate biopsy of every benign palpable finding or declare all clips unreliable.
claims.verificationScope: Offline author synthesis/application from recorded claims and their existing source records; no fresh source retrieval, source-access-date change or clinical approval. Direct alignment of the application remains for independent clinical/source review.

claims.statement: New pain, irreducibility, vomiting and bowel dilatation proximal to a hernia with distal collapse require urgent surgical assessment despite a prior elective cirrhosis-optimization plan.
claims.applicablePopulation: Only the explicitly described synthetic adult question-flag round-three profiles.
claims.limitation: Application of the explicit urgent-emergency exception. The pattern does not establish bowel necrosis or a specific operation; no laboratory correction target is proposed.
claims.verificationScope: Offline author synthesis/application from recorded claims and their existing source records; no fresh source retrieval, source-access-date change or clinical approval. Direct alignment of the application remains for independent clinical/source review.

claims.statement: In the supplied controlled record, smaller end-diastolic volume with similar ejection fraction supports reduced filling, while a higher plateau pressure during passive inspiratory holds at fixed delivered volume and measured total PEEP supports an increased elastic pressure requirement.
claims.applicablePopulation: Only the explicitly described synthetic adult question-flag round-three profiles.
claims.limitation: Physical interpretation rather than proof of a unique cause or exclusion of mixed mechanisms. No new operative management, measured numeric range or ventilator setting is taught.
claims.verificationScope: Offline author synthesis/application from recorded claims and their existing source records; no fresh source retrieval, source-access-date change or clinical approval. Direct alignment of the application remains for independent clinical/source review.

claims.statement: Removal of the breast gland with retention of the skin envelope is a mastectomy rather than a localized breast-conserving excision; the conventional pure-DCIS axillary staging distinction follows the gland operation.
claims.applicablePopulation: Only the explicitly described synthetic adult question-flag round-three profiles.
claims.limitation: Anatomical application of the recorded standard-operation rule. No delayed-tracer strategy or universal oncoplastic-operation rule is added.
claims.verificationScope: Offline author synthesis/application from recorded claims and their existing source records; no fresh source retrieval, source-access-date change or clinical approval. Direct alignment of the application remains for independent clinical/source review.

claims.statement: A pH fall from above to within the laboratory reference interval is not demonstrated acidemia, even when arterial CO2 rises; direction of change and the later acid-base state are separate interpretations.
claims.applicablePopulation: Only the explicitly described synthetic adult question-flag round-three profiles.
claims.limitation: Reference-interval/definition inference without invented numeric values, a compensation formula, proof of CO2 source or a ventilator adjustment.
claims.verificationScope: Offline author synthesis/application from recorded claims and their existing source records; no fresh source retrieval, source-access-date change or clinical approval. Direct alignment of the application remains for independent clinical/source review.

claims.statement: When the agreed temporary directive ends after reassessed return to the pre-anaesthetic cardiopulmonary condition, continuation of unchanged chronic baseline oxygen does not by itself extend the modification.
claims.applicablePopulation: Only the explicitly described synthetic adult question-flag round-three profiles.
claims.limitation: Only the explicitly stipulated patient agreement; not an institutional default, oxygen target, recovery scale or jurisdiction-specific legal rule.
claims.verificationScope: Offline author synthesis/application from recorded claims and their existing source records; no fresh source retrieval, source-access-date change or clinical approval. Direct alignment of the application remains for independent clinical/source review.

claims.statement: For the supplied severe hyperkalaemic hospital episode after calcium, insulin with glucose supplies the primary immediate intracellular-shift treatment; nebulized salbutamol is an adjunct and routine intravenous bicarbonate is not its preferred substitute in a non-acidemic record.
claims.applicablePopulation: Only the explicitly described synthetic adult question-flag round-three profiles.
claims.limitation: The mechanism/threshold basis is locally recorded, but this comparative drug-ranking synthesis requires direct UKKA section alignment before release acceptance. No dose, insulin safety protocol, repeat timing or renal-replacement threshold is inferred.
claims.verificationScope: Offline author synthesis/application from recorded claims and their existing source records; no fresh source retrieval, source-access-date change or clinical approval. Direct alignment of the application remains for independent clinical/source review.

claims.statement: A cyst-fluid sample without lesional cells does not represent a separate solid mural component; targeted needle sampling of that component can address the specific diagnostic deficit before open biopsy.
claims.applicablePopulation: Only the explicitly described synthetic adult question-flag round-three profiles.
claims.limitation: Sampling/representation application, not proof of malignancy, a guarantee of FNA adequacy or a universal preference for FNA over core.
claims.verificationScope: Offline author synthesis/application from recorded claims and their existing source records; no fresh source retrieval, source-access-date change or clinical approval. Direct alignment of the application remains for independent clinical/source review.

claims.statement: A reassuring daytime-sleepiness report does not cancel a separate increased apnoea-probability assessment; that risk information can inform current perioperative communication before diagnostic confirmation.
claims.applicablePopulation: Only the explicitly described synthetic adult question-flag round-three profiles.
claims.limitation: Communication/assessment scope only. No diagnostic cutoff, CPAP prescription, required monitoring protocol or decision to delay surgery is derived.
claims.verificationScope: Offline author synthesis/application from recorded claims and their existing source records; no fresh source retrieval, source-access-date change or clinical approval. Direct alignment of the application remains for independent clinical/source review.

claims.statement: Testing preimplantation recipient serum against donor targets can investigate whether donor-directed recipient reactivity predated implantation; a result confined to a postfailure sample cannot establish its earlier presence.
claims.applicablePopulation: Only the explicitly described synthetic adult question-flag round-three profiles.
claims.limitation: Temporal/target inference only. It does not specify test performance, antigen identity, exclusion of a technical cause, a Banff diagnosis or treatment.
claims.verificationScope: Offline author synthesis/application from recorded claims and their existing source records; no fresh source retrieval, source-access-date change or clinical approval. Direct alignment of the application remains for independent clinical/source review.

claims.statement: In a recurrent varicose-vein case with incompletely connected posterior and medial reflux findings, a superficial/deep reflux map can establish the anatomical contributions before another intervention target is selected.
claims.applicablePopulation: Only the explicitly described synthetic adult question-flag round-three profiles.
claims.limitation: Case-specific scope inference from the recorded SVS/AVF/AVLS sources; direct recurrent-mapping section alignment is pending. No acquisition-position or duration rule, iliac imaging indication or compulsory ablation is taught.
claims.verificationScope: Offline author synthesis/application from recorded claims and their existing source records; no fresh source retrieval, source-access-date change or clinical approval. Direct alignment of the application remains for independent clinical/source review.

claims.statement: A discrete superficial cavity with mobile internal echoes and no internal flow, separate from deep fascia and a compressible adjacent vein, supports a focal collection rather than attributing the swelling to that vein.
claims.applicablePopulation: Only the explicitly described synthetic adult question-flag round-three profiles.
claims.limitation: Qualitative sonographic application to the supplied stable superficial case, not a universal Doppler criterion or drainage technique for deep, vascular or plantar disease.
claims.verificationScope: Offline author synthesis/application from recorded claims and their existing source records; no fresh source retrieval, source-access-date change or clinical approval. Direct alignment of the application remains for independent clinical/source review.

claims.statement: Detectable thyroglobulin washout after a needle path through an intact thyroid requires cautious interpretation with node cytology and morphology; discordant findings can warrant representative repeat node sampling before an irreversible lateral-neck plan.
claims.applicablePopulation: Only the explicitly described synthetic adult question-flag round-three profiles.
claims.limitation: Application of the recorded intact-thyroid limitation; endocrine source-alignment review is pending. Detectability is not authored as a diagnostic threshold and no required operation or extent is inferred.
claims.verificationScope: Offline author synthesis/application from recorded claims and their existing source records; no fresh source retrieval, source-access-date change or clinical approval. Direct alignment of the application remains for independent clinical/source review.

claims.statement: Benign breast tissue that does not explain the suspicious imaging target warrants further representative histologic assessment.
claims.limitation: Repeat core, vacuum-assisted or surgical sampling may be appropriate. The missed-target case does not rank all possible techniques universally; skin sampling alone does not clear an unsampled parenchymal lesion.
claims.applicablePopulation: The identified synthetic adult clinical or employee teaching cases; observed values are constructed case inputs, not empirical patient/gameplay data.

claims.statement: Suspicious cervical-node imaging can require targeted FNA and selected thyroglobulin washout despite a nondiagnostic cystic-fluid aspirate.
claims.limitation: Single adequate current primary guideline; washout interpretation with an intact thyroid has limitations. The fictional 12-mm short axis is an observation above the documented sampling criterion, not an invented criterion.
claims.applicablePopulation: The identified synthetic adult clinical or employee teaching cases; observed values are constructed case inputs, not empirical patient/gameplay data.

claims.statement: Conservative care remains reasonable when preference, comorbidity, mobility, anatomy, or resources weigh against intervention.
claims.limitation: No universal garment or duration is prescribed.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with stable symptomatic varicose veins.

claims.statement: For symptomatic axial superficial reflux in an intervention candidate who wants treatment, specialist superficial venous intervention assessment is preferred to mandatory long-term compression.
claims.limitation: The exact procedure depends on specialist anatomy and assessment.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with symptomatic axial superficial reflux who are intervention candidates.

claims.statement: Duplex ultrasound with reflux assessment is the diagnostic test of choice for evaluating symptomatic lower-extremity chronic venous reflux.
claims.limitation: The existing service must be labeled for reflux assessment, not only acute DVT compression.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with symptomatic varicose veins being evaluated for treatment.
